title: Scientific Modelling and Dimensional Analysis
summary: One versioned model record for three tools: the Dimensionless Number Finder, the Model Nondimensionalizer and the Regime Map Builder. Enter variables with units, equations and conditions; the page checks dimensions, units, absolute and difference temperatures, conditions and closures before analysis. The Finder row-reduces the dimension matrix with exact rational arithmetic and returns the n − r independent groups with their exponent equations, checks and familiar names. The Nondimensionalizer suggests and checks scales, substitutes into every equation and condition with exact symbolic algebra, removes each common factor and checks the reverse substitution. The Regime Map Builder links the record to a declared model of the catalogue (lumped bodies, transient slab, cylinder and sphere, a slab with a source, a two-layer wall with contact resistance, a straight fin, a Boussinesq layer heated from below, three radiation models, and the structures models: the Euler column, a beam under uniform and axial load, the elastica, a damped oscillator, beam vibration modes, a Navier plate, a cylindrical shell and two thermoelastic models, and the flow models: laminar pipe and channel flow with a uniform wall heat flux, isentropic air in a converging-diverging nozzle, shallow water with a hydraulic jump, the Blasius boundary layer and a Joukowski airfoil with thin-airfoil theory), derives its dominant balances and asymptotic expansions order by order, and maps where each approximation meets a tolerance, with balance crossovers, unresolved regions, limit paths and the dimensional values of any point. Stability and bifurcation analysis (piece 4) checks the base state and the perturbation equations exactly, solves the eigenvalue problems, follows branches by continuation and classifies folds, branch points and Hopf points only with their checked conditions: Rayleigh–Bénard onset with the nonlinear roll branch against published data, a lumped body and a duct with grey radiation, convection with radiation, custom ODE systems with folds, hysteresis and a cusp, and the structures: the Euler critical load π² with its modes and no claim after buckling, and the elastica's supercritical pitchfork from an exact series, with its eccentric branches. The flow models check f·Re = 64 and Nu = 48/11 exactly, the sonic throat and the choked mass flow of the nozzle with the shock range left as a separate declaration, the hydraulic jump exactly in a quadratic field, the Blasius f''(0) against mpmath, and the Kutta–Joukowski lift by pressure integration. The convective heat-transfer models check Couette heating, the thermocapillary return flow with its transport factor 1 + Ma²/1680 and mixed convection with its reversal boundary Gr/Re = 72 exactly, the Graetz eigenvalue of a tube against mpmath with the uniform-flux value 48/11 kept apart, advection–diffusion with exact discrete conservation, and a conjugate fluid–solid channel on three meshes; an empirical layer draws the cited ranges of the flat-plate and vertical-wall correlations and refuses them outside, and imported numerical results are compared with them when the file states its provenance. Piece 8 adds parallel-flow and counterflow heat exchangers (effectiveness, the heat balance and the exact balanced limit), the two-phase Stefan model of melting (λ against mpmath, the latent-energy balance and an independent transient front), Nusselt film condensation (an exact latent-energy balance and the film states), Rohsenow's pool-boiling correlation with the peak heat flux and a strict fluid, surface, pressure and regime domain, and a grey absorbing slab with its optically thin, opaque and Rosseland limits. Piece 9 adds fluid–structure interaction, the last of the 26 families: the Georgia Tech typical airfoil section in pitch and plunge, with the flutter onset from Theodorsen's function (k and p–k methods) and from a state space with the R. T. Jones approximation of the Wagner function, which agree within 1 %, the exact divergence speed, the modal damping against speed, RK4 convergence of order 4, and the nonlinear amplitude kept unresolved. A release test checks every family, the 23 heat-transfer examples and the agreement of page, report and deck. Every result carries one of six statuses, its inputs, its derivation and its sources; SymPy and mpmath reference values check the engine. A Markdown report and a narrated beamdswitch deck come from the same model version. Works offline: MathJax 4.1.3 and Fira Math are embedded.
